visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a person's hands at a beige cutting board, slicing the end off a whole white onion with a large chef's knife. The person wears a white long-sleeved shirt. In the background, a red ceramic pot and various colorful kitchen utensils are visible. (2) The onion is sliced into very thin, translucent strips. The camera maintains a tight close-up on the knife's movement. Detailed text overlays appear on the right side of the screen explaining health benefits. (3) The sliced onions are gathered and placed into a clear glass jar. The person then presents a bottle of white balsamic vinegar to the camera, showcasing the label before beginning to pour the liquid over the onions. (4) Honey is poured from a small yellow measuring cup into the jar. A spoon is used to stir the onions, vinegar, and honey together until well-mixed. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food. (5) The person places a white lid on the glass jar and presses a button in the center to create a vacuum seal. Two other similar jars are visible in the background, suggesting a batch process. Final serving instructions appear as text overlays.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 超級簡單的又健康的『醋漬洋蔥』. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. (2) [Subtitle]: 很久之前看過這日本食譜. (3) [Subtitle]: 怕做出來很嗆嚨又酸一直沒勇氣做... (4) [Slogan]: 『醋漬洋蔥』的益處：幫助消化、抗氧化、抗發炎 幫助控制血糖、促進腸道健康 低熱量、增加風味！ 也降低洋蔥的嗆辣感. (5) [Subtitle]: 只要將洋蔥切成絲 或者小丁就可以了！ (6) [Subtitle]: 準備玻璃容器 把切好的洋蔥絲放進來. (7) [Subtitle]: 你可以使用釀造米醋 或『義大利白巴薩米克醋』 天然釀造無化學、無添加糖. (8) [Subtitle]: 一般純米醋做出來會 比較嗆味. (9) [Subtitle]: 巴薩米克醋做出來 味道會比較溫和 真的蠻好吃的喔！ (10) [Subtitle]: 先放半顆的洋蔥絲 大約加到三分滿. (11) [Subtitle]: 等一下洋蔥軟化 就可以補更多的洋蔥絲進來. (12) [Subtitle]: 約一大匙的蜂蜜. (13) [Subtitle]: 拌一拌，洋蔥就會減小體積. (14) [Subtitle]: 再補更多的洋蔥絲進來. (15) [Subtitle]: 醃製後洋蔥會變得溫和、適合拌沙拉、夾三明治、配燒肉都很好！ 加入料理也可以. (16) [Subtitle]: 像這樣冰箱冷藏 4小時就可以吃了 試試看，真的蠻好吃的喔！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat pop music with an acoustic guitar rhythm and female vocals singing in English begins immediately. A clear, friendly female voice narrating in Mandarin Chinese starts the introduction. Sharp, rhythmic percussive 'thwack' sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board occur with high transient brightness. (2) The chopping sound pauses. The narrator continues as the background music maintains its steady tempo. A distinct 'thud' and the sound of glass friction occur as a jar is handled. The narrator's speech is enunciated and high-fidelity. (3) A soft, continuous 'glug-glug' liquid pouring sound accompanies the visual of vinegar entering the jar. This is followed by a shorter, thicker pouring sound representing honey. The narrator's voice changes pitch slightly to emphasize certain ingredients. (4) The sound of a metal spoon clinking against the glass jar is audible as the narrator explains the mixing process. The music swell slightly in volume as the instructional part concludes. (5) A final mechanical click and a soft 'whoosh' of air occur as the vacuum lid is pressed and sealed. The music begins to fade out smoothly as the narrator provides a final sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an instructional guide to demonstrate how to prepare 'Vinegar Pickled Onions.' It combines high-quality visual close-ups of food preparation with a friendly, informative narration to encourage viewers to try a simple and healthy recipe. The inclusion of text-based health benefits reinforces the value proposition of the dish.
